items.text: Baltimore (Thu practice): DNP - DT Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring). LIMITED - S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee), CB Chidobe Awuzie (back), G Vega Ioane (hand). FULL - RB Derrick Henry (concussion protocol, expected to play), WRs Zay Flowers, Rashod Bateman. Lamar Jackson (thumb) on IR; Jacoby Brissett starts.
Baltimore: CB Marlon Humphrey back at practice after team-discipline deactivation; status TBD.

Houston (Wed practice): DNP - DE Danielle Hunter (hamstring, out since Wk10), DT Sheldon Rankins (ankle), LG Keylan Rutledge (stinger), WR Kayshon Boutte (hip), TE Brevin Jordan. LIMITED - WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring, trending to play). FULL - RB Woody Marks (concussion). IR - LB Azeez Al-Shaair. C.J. Stroud starts.
